chunks: So has God, all-mighty and all-wise, been revealing to you and to others before you.

key_terms.يُوحِي: Divine revelation or sending down of guidance

ai.seo_question: How does the Quran describe the continuity of revelation to Prophet Muhammad and previous prophets?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the universality of Wahy (revelation) as the primary source of divine law, linking the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) directly to the lineage of earlier prophets through the same divine source. It reinforces the concept of Tawhid in prophethood, where Allah's attributes of Al-Aziz (The Mighty) and Al-Hakim (The Wise) ensure the coherence and authority of the message across different eras.
